training.seed_check: 10111001, 30111001, 1110003, 1110004: no occurrence in any json/jsonl/py/md/txt/log file under experiments, scripts, config, docs, evaluation before this registration
training.counting: learner and frozen decisions are logged separately; the cap is on their total
training.collection: natural duels (normal dealing and draws; fresh env per episode; player 0 moves first), learner seat alternates per episode starting with seat 0; frozen side = start model; both sides sample from their own logits; common position adapter for both sides
training.window: closes at the first learner decision or episode end after >= 128 environment decisions, or at the cap
training.update: per window: one PPO epoch, 4 contiguous chunks (<= 32 learner decisions, stored rollout RNN state at chunk start); each chunk is one minibatch with 2 rehearsal sequences; one Adam step per minibatch
training.loss_exclusions: select_position (adapter-owned) steps of the learner are history only

rehearsal.per_block: 14 old / 1 C1 / 1 C2 per 16 sequences, slot order shuffled by rehearsal_seed; old slots uniform with replacement from the 12 old train sequences
rehearsal.loss: CE of the demonstrated label (single acceptable action), mean over the minibatch loss steps

training.candidate: state after the last window; no checkpoint selection; not adopted
checks_after_save: reload through the isolated entry with the saved hashes
logits on the C1/C2 histories: memory vs saved equal
neural argmax and position-adapter final actions checked separately
training.exposure_check: each episode records each player's own hand at its first decision (exact 5 cards when that is in turn 1, otherwise a superset after the draw); compared with the evaluation hands by multiset; overlaps are reported, never replaced

order: NT1 start C1, C2, C1v, C2v (4)
NT1 candidate C1, C2, C1v, C2v (4)

rt1.baseline: start-model passing set: g06/g07 from this pilot, g08-g11 reused from experiments/artmage-parallel-20261110/regression (identical to the original records)
rt1.retention: candidate keeps every baseline-passing case; new passes on baseline failures allowed; never judged by counts
rt1.stop: identical to check_other_positions (goal_reached / opponent_main_phase_passed / two_turns_passed / episode_finished, 320 decisions)

nt1.stop: first decision of turn 4 (end of own turn 3), game over from env.step returns, or 600 environment decisions (cap is not success)
nt1.player1: common pass policy every turn; first legal option as a logged fallback when it cannot decide
nt1.model: free, position adapter on; no scripts or goals in its inputs
nt1.fixture_property: both players hold the same 5 cards; no normal draws in fixture duels (native draw count 0); turn 3 is observed without a draw
records: own turn 1 end / opponent turn 2 end / own turn 3 end boards with LP
every action with its legal alternatives
offered vs used vs resolved effects
legacy Assault goal as a diagnostic only

evaluation.variant_failure_rule: if a variant script fails, record it and revise the plan before training or viewing other results; no search for another hand
